dedupe_keys.name: 福岡市駐輪場の自転車検知テータ cycling networks

description: 福岡市駐輪場の自転車検知データ [cycling networks] is a dataset listed in BODIK Open Data Catalogue Service (data.bodik.jp), Japanese local governments, an open data portal, published or maintained by 公益財団法人九州先端科学技術研究所. 福岡市の2024年度mirai@協働事業「西新駅中央駐輪場の混雑状況をリアルタイムで判定」する実証実験を実施した際に、AIカメラにより計測された利用者と自転車の検知結果の15分ごとの統計データ。 データでは、日時、クラス（person / bicycle）、入場、退場、その他（滞留等）、入場の累積値、退場の累積値、滞留の累積値を集計。. Coverage: Japan. The portal files it under the publisher 公益財団法人九州先端科学技術研究所. Its tags are 人流, 統計. It offers 41 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2024-12-06 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-bodik-portal.
